{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true prices, showing 3-6 dollar lag behind current levels",
    "Lag magnitude increases with price momentum, early in history 1-2 dollar lag but expands to 5+ dollars in later periods",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price: high sentiment (1.0) always aligns with price increases, low/negative sentiment with declines",
    "Model fails to capture sentiment inflection points - uses average sentiment when sentiment should be extreme",
    "Price mean-reversion is missing from forecasts; model continues trending when prices should normalize",
    "Sentiment strength is not proportionally reflected - medium sentiments (0.3-0.7) produce flat forecasts regardless of sentiment value",
    "Forecasts are too conservative on the upside when sentiment is strong (1.0), underestimating true price momentum by 3-5 dollars"
  ]
}
